This is the Arizona Pet Waste Field App. It runs the whole route business from a phone. Here is exactly what it does.
This is the Schedule. It shows every yard for the day, how many are done, any problems, and any texts waiting to send. New sign ups that do not have a day yet show up right here.
Plan the week picks the day and the scooper for every yard. You set how many yards one scooper does in a day. No day ever goes over that number.
Tap the button and it builds the week. It groups yards by town, so a day stays in one area and the truck drives less. It also tells you how many scoopers you need.
Here is the whole week on a map. Every dot is a yard. Each color is a day.
Tap any day to see it in driving order, with the miles and the towns.
Need to lighten a day? Open the route, tap move yards to another day, and pick a group.
Before anything moves, the app tells you what it costs. The extra miles, and the extra time, at ten minutes a yard. It marks the best day, and it asks, are you sure?
The yards land on the new day, back in driving order.
Now the scooper. He signs in with his email and a code. No password. His route is already built in the best driving order, with a map.
He works one yard at a time. He sees the address, the gate code, the notes, and buttons to navigate or call.
At the yard, he taps arrived, taps each box, and takes one photo of the latched gate.
That photo is the proof of the visit, so it can not get lost. If the signal is weak, the picture stays on the phone until it sends.
The photo finishes the yard, and the next yard opens on its own. A text to the next customer is ready to send with one tap.
The customer gets a link. No app, and no login. They watch the truck on a live map and see how many minutes away it is. When the yard is done, they get the gate photo.
That is the Field App. One tool for the office, the scooper, and the customer.
